final_message: I parsed the log file by reading it line by line, detecting the start of each log entry by the timestamp, level, service, and message pattern. I collected extra lines as part of the entry until the next entry or a repeat line was found. I converted timestamps to UTC in the required format, filtered only ERROR and CRITICAL entries, extracted the last line of the traceback as the exception (or null if none), and summed repeat counts from the repeat lines. I then aggregated counts by service and wrote the structured JSON output to workspace/errors.json.
